summary: Defines PANA, a network-layer transport for EAP that lets clients authenticate to an access network. In EAP terms it is a UDP-based lower layer between the EAP peer and the authenticator. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Before using a school network you must show your pass. PANA carries that proof over the network itself, even without special wires.

questions: eap over udp for network access
protocol for carrying authentication for network access
